spec.description: Production dashboard for Kafka ingestion, Nimbo realtime processing, and StarRocks Stream Load health.
Kafka records consumed per second across all realtime consumers. A drop to zero indicates stalled consumption.
spec.title: Kafka Ingestion Throughput

spec.description: Kafka offset commit rate grouped by success or failure. Failures should remain at zero.
spec.title: Kafka Commit Outcomes

spec.description: NetFlow rows successfully loaded into StarRocks per second.
spec.title: StarRocks Ingestion Throughput

spec.description: Stream Load requests submitted to StarRocks per second.
spec.title: StarRocks Load Requests / Second

spec.description: Percentage of completed Stream Load operations that are accepted as successful. Success and publish_timeout are treated as accepted outcomes.
spec.title: Stream Load Success

spec.description: Cumulative successful Stream Load completions per worker. Large imbalance can indicate a worker or partition distribution problem.
spec.title: Completed Stream Loads by Worker

spec.description: Age of the oldest unfinished Stream Load. A rising value is a strong signal of stuck or slow StarRocks loads.
spec.title: Oldest Inflight Load Age

spec.description: Retry rate grouped by reason. Normal operation should stay near zero.
spec.title: Stream Load Retries

spec.description: Completed async Stream Load futures waiting for the consumer thread to drain them. Should stay near zero.
spec.title: Futures Waiting to Drain

spec.description: Number of failed async Stream Load futures during the last 5 minutes. Expected value is zero.
spec.title: Failed Futures (5m)

spec.description: Realtime record processing rate grouped by success and error outcome.
spec.title: Record Processing Outcomes

spec.description: Cumulative Kafka records consumed since the current consumer processes started. Use throughput panels for current rate.
spec.title: Total Kafka Records Consumed

spec.description: Number of Nimbo realtime consumer workers currently running. Expected value is 3.
spec.title: Realtime Workers Running

spec.description: Current Kafka backlog. Rising lag means ingestion is falling behind production.
spec.title: Kafka Consumer Lag

spec.description: Total Kafka partitions currently assigned to the realtime consumer group.
spec.title: Assigned Kafka Partitions

spec.description: Average number of rows submitted per batch over 5 minutes, grouped by worker.
spec.title: Average Batch Size by Worker

spec.description: Current Stream Load requests still in flight. Sustained growth indicates StarRocks or network pressure.
spec.title: Inflight Stream Loads
Nimbo Realtime → StarRocks Pipeline Health
